title: Be A Diva Eau De Parfum

details.description: Be A Diva is a bold and empowering fragrance that exudes confidence and sophistication. It opens with a top note of cassis and is laced with hints of floral peony, rose, jasmine, and violet. The woody and musky base notes provide a sensual and alluring finish. Its timeless and classic scent makes it a go-to choice for you. Feel unapologetically confident and command attention wherever you go. Add a touch of luxury and unleash your inner Diva!
details.usageInstructions:
Apply perfume to pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind ears, where body heat enhances scent.
Spritz from a distance, and avoid rubbing, allowing the fragrance to naturally develop and linger.

details.description: She's ambitious, she's beautiful, she's hardworking, she's social - She needs to shine as bright as stars in the sky. Yardley's new perfume is the final touch that completes her. Be a Star opens up with notes of bergamot, blends with a heart of floral geranium and lily of the valley. The base notes of amber and musk provide a sensual and sophisticated finish. It's the perfect scent for a night out in the town, a special event, or any occasion when you want to feel unstoppable and unforgettable. Designed to make you the centre of attention - just like a star all day long! Let yourself shine through.
details.usageInstructions:
Apply Eau De Parfum to pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind ears, where body heat enhances scent.
Spritz from a distance, and avoid rubbing, allowing the fragrance to naturally develop and linger.

details.description: Yardley's signature fragrance - English Lavender is created using the world's finest natural lavender oils and over 200 years' expertise. The English Lavender Eau De Toilette combines the floral freshness of lavender with caring accords of musk to create a delicate and sophisticated fragrance that is a pleasure to wear.

details.description: The undisputed queen of flowers, the rose is the ultimate ode to femininity. details.description: Evoke the enchanting scents of the English countryside with Yardley London's Country Breeze Compact Perfume for Women. This charming fragrance encapsulates the essence of lush, untouched meadows, where the gentle breeze carries the fragrance of wildflowers. Country Breeze is a sparkling perfume that opens with a lively burst of Mandarin and Bergamot, instantly awakening your senses and inviting you to embark on a sensory journey. At its heart lies the refined elegance of Jasmine and Freesia, creating a harmonious floral symphony that's both captivating and alluring. Now, you can carry the spirit of the countryside with you wherever you go, thanks to this convenient, on-the-go format from The House of Yardley. It's a delightful invitation to embrace the beauty and tranquillity of the English countryside, no matter where you are. With a legacy spanning over 250 years, Yardley London is a brand synonymous with Englishness, luxury, quality, and the allure of natural fragrances. Trust in a brand that's celebrated for delivering authentic, premium-quality floral fragrances and personal care products. Country Breeze Compact Perfume is more than just a scent; it's an expression of your love for the English countryside, capturing the essence of wildflower-filled meadows and the tranquillity of a countryside breeze. Elevate your daily ritual with this exquisite fragrance and feel the enchantment of the countryside envelop you.
details.usageInstructions: Hold it upright and 15 cm away from the skin and spray.
